obligations.correspondingSource: GPL-covered libmpv/FFmpeg and linked non-system components require applicable corresponding source, modifications and necessary build/install scripts. Preserve component notices and satisfy the NSIS LZMA module CPL source/notice conditions and exception.
obligations.permissiveComponents: Preserve applicable MIT/Apache-2.0 notices and terms, including dependency notices. MIT does not require plugin source disclosure, an exact Cargo.lock, or byte-identical rebuilds.
obligations.evidenceGaps: Corrected KlinoffBuilds RC1 binary/source pairs replace the former third-party media evidence. Final combined-work review and installer correspondence remain release gates.

verificationPolicy.integrity: Pinned SHA-256 hashes, complete tool inventories, source-state checks, locked dependency verification and compiler notice recollection are internal safeguards supporting release review.
verificationPolicy.reproducibility: Byte-identical rebuilds are not a release requirement. Exact plugin/toolchain build records can improve provenance but must not be represented as standalone MIT obligations.
verificationPolicy.approval: These distinctions do not approve public redistribution or waive applicable corresponding-source and notice obligations.
